questions.q: What is the full form of EDI in electronic commerce?
questions.e: EDI is the computer-to-computer exchange of standard-format business documents, such as purchase orders and invoices, between trading partners.

questions.q: An online platform where individuals sell used goods directly to other individuals is an example of ______ e-commerce.
questions.e: In consumer-to-consumer (C2C) commerce, consumers trade with each other, usually through a third-party marketplace or classified site.

questions.q: Which of the following statements about UPI is NOT correct?
o: It works on top of IMPS
It allows instant real-time money transfer
questions.e: UPI was developed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), not by SEBI, which regulates the securities market.

questions.q: SET, a protocol for secure card payments over the Internet, stands for ______.
questions.e: SET was developed by Visa and MasterCard to protect credit card transactions on open networks.

questions.q: Which of the following is the international EDI standard maintained under the United Nations?
questions.e: UN/EDIFACT is the international EDI standard. ANSI X12 is the North American standard.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about digital certificates.
I. A certificate issued by a Certifying Authority binds the owner's private key to the owner's identity.
II. A certificate contains the owner's identity and public key, signed by the CA.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only II is correct. A certificate such as X.509 carries the owner's public key. The private key is never placed in a certificate and must stay secret.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about UPI.
I. A payer can send money using a virtual payment address without revealing a bank account number.
II. UPI transfers can be made only during bank working hours.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: UPI uses virtual payment addresses (VPAs) and works round the clock on all days, including holidays. So statement II is wrong.

questions.q: A business model in which the firm earns a commission by bringing buyers and sellers together is called the ______ model.
questions.e: Brokerage sites such as marketplaces and auction sites earn fees or commissions on transactions they enable. Subscription charges recurring fees for access.

questions.q: In the SET protocol, the dual signature is used so that ______.
o: the merchant sees the order but not the card details, and the bank sees the payment but not the order
the merchant can read the card number
two merchants can sign one order
the message is compressed before encryption
questions.e: The dual signature links order information and payment information through a combined hash. The merchant gets only the order details and the bank only the payment details.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about PCI DSS.
I. It is a security standard for organisations that handle payment card data.
II. It is a law enacted by the Parliament of India.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: PCI DSS is an industry standard from the Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council, founded by the major card brands. It is not an Indian law.
